rules.rule: On a synthetic AI-persona panel, loss framing lowered appeal by 1.27 points on a 1-10 scale (90% CI -1.38 to -1.04; 4 variants, 4 concepts), but the finding is fragile.
rules.advice: Prefer gain framing as a default, but treat this as a tentative signal from AI personas, not real customers, and test loss-framed copy with real audiences before ruling it out.
